answer: One-Time Oscillator Lease: the verifier issues a challenge seeded by a public tundra weather feed. The agent must return a hash of a fresh quartz-jitter trace sampled over a fixed wall-clock window, mixed with a nectar-viscosity calibration nonce, before expiry. Cloned agents produce correlated jitter and fail cross-correlation; replay fails because each answer binds the challenge and expires. Attacker cost: one independent physical oscillator plus one serial wait per Sybil
